2026-11-03.summary: Wet regime: cloudy, mild night, then a gale-force Gulf front Tuesday afternoon puts most of the rain late in the window. Low from the raw blend (not NBM), wind from IFS nudged up, rain near the middle of the guidance.

2026-11-04.summary: Wet frontal day: heavy rain early in the window, then a second band and a possible midday dry slot. Going with near-consensus temps (47/39), IFS-weighted wind of 17 kt and 0.65" of rain, just under the IFS/HRRR ~0.72".

2026-11-05.summary: A wet morning from low #2's rain, then drying Thursday afternoon before the next big front, which mostly arrives after the window. Near-consensus temperatures, wind nudged toward IFS, precip slightly above consensus toward IFS.

2026-11-06.summary: My forecast for PAYA is high 46 °F, low 39 °F, max wind 24 kt and precip 0.65". A deep Gulf low passes to the west, and it's a gale day, so I'm forecasting wind well above the 18 kt consensus, using the models' errors on past gale days and the AFD's 20–25 kt. Temperatures are near the consensus. Precip is shaded below the guidance median toward the AFD's half inch.

2026-11-07.summary: The departing gale gives a wet, breezy start: about 16 kt early and about 0.6" of rain before 15Z. It then turns calm and partly clear, with the low around 35 late Saturday evening. Values are near consensus, shaded slightly lower on precip and the low.

2026-11-08.summary: A lull between storms: the front stays south and the next rain arrives after the window. Near consensus: high 42, low 33 under clouds, 10 kt from early NE outflow (per IFS), and light precip of 0.03.

2026-11-09.summary: A short lull before a storm-force Gulf low, with the front's wind and rain arriving at the end of the window. High at consensus 46; low 33 from early clearing; wind 27 for the late gale ramp; precip 0.42, in the upper third of guidance.

2026-11-10.summary: The day starts in the tail of the storm-force low: a gale around 06Z (25 kt) and front-tail rain, then a lull. The next system's rain arrives before 06Z. I stayed close to consensus: high 45, low 38, wind 25 kt, precip 0.40".

2026-11-11.summary: Second gale-force low lifts up the panhandle Wednesday, with a lull overnight and the front around 00Z. High at consensus 46, low 38 as in today's lull, wind 22 for a brief frontal burst, precip 0.63 above consensus because the IFS/USL/ENS group did best today.

2026-11-12.summary: The high comes at the 06Z start, in a warm push models run 2–5 °F too cold (45). Overnight wave rain of about 0.60" ends Thursday afternoon; north flow then drops the low to about 34 by 06Z. Wind peaks early near 15 kt.

2026-11-13.summary: A lull between systems with northerly outflow overnight. I stay near consensus with a slightly warm high (43) and low (32), light wind (8 kt), and a token 0.02" for a weak wave arriving late in the window.

2026-11-14.summary: An overnight frontal rain band, then a lull before Sunday's gale. I'm forecasting a low of 33 near the 06Z start (calm, saturated cold pool), a high of 44 after mixing, 10 kt wind, and 0.47" of rain, a bit wetter than the 0.40 consensus since this is an overnight wave.

2026-11-15.summary: Lull in drying E/NE flow ahead of the Sunday-night front at PAYA. I stay near consensus but a bit wetter and warmer: rain lingers or the front arrives early (0.08"), and warm advection and downslope push the high to 48F. Low 39F, wind 11 kt.

2026-11-16.summary: My forecast is 46/38, 18 kt, 0.80". A warm sector at the 06Z start comes ahead of a secondary front and a second front Monday. I sit near consensus: a degree or so warmer on the high because the models are running cold and dry now, wind at IFS minus 2, and rain in the middle to upper middle of the guidance.

2026-11-17.summary: An overnight rain wave, then a short lull, then a stronger warm-advection front in the afternoon. I stay near consensus: 1 °F warmer on the high and low for the warm push and steady rain, wind 17 kt from the afternoon front, and about 1" of rain because this station keeps verifying wetter than guidance.

2026-11-18.summary: The front's showery tail fades as a ridge builds. Warm air that models are under-forecasting means a high of 43 and low of 36 (both 1–2F above consensus); light winds near 8 kt; showers near the ensemble medians at 0.17".

2026-11-19.summary: Warm-advection rain ahead of Thursday's front: temperatures climb to about 44F late, the low near 37 under overcast and moist air, winds rising to about 18 kt by evening, and a soaking of about 0.9 in near the ensemble medians.

2026-11-20.summary: The front's warm sector gives a high near 44 in heavy early rain, about 0.70" of rain overall and southeast winds near 20 kt. Then drier air and partial clearing behind the front drop the low to about 32 by 06Z Saturday.

Front overhead at the window start: warm high near 45 and peak wind near 19 kt early, then clearing and calm bring a 33 low by evening. Rain 0.70", upper-middle of guidance because the front is running late.

today.summary: Clearing and a building ridge behind today's front give a dry, calm day. The low goes below consensus toward MOS for a clear night, and the high sits near consensus with cold air arriving: 38/26/6/0.00.

2026-11-20.summary: The front is running late and weak. Its overnight warm sector sets a high near 44, and post-frontal drying gives a 34 low at 06Z. Wind is trimmed to 19 kt because IFS and GFS are overdoing today's wind. Rain is 0.60", near the consensus and QMD median.

today.summary: Dry and clearing behind the front as northerly outflow begins. I go near or below consensus on the high because cold air is arriving, lean toward MOS on the low for the clear Saturday evening, keep winds light, and enter zero precip.
